quotes.quote: Brilliant architecture, fantastic setting, and exceptional artifacts from the life of Theodore Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Rachel K.

quotes.quote: The grounds around  the Library are gorgeous.  The views are breathtaking.
quotes.author: R C.

quotes.quote: I have a real (as real as it gets) conversation with Teddy himself in the holographic chamber.
quotes.author: Joe V.

quotes.quote: The galleries are well laid out and the amount of history there was amazing.
quotes.author: Jay J.

quotes.quote: Beautiful views, well maintained landscape, well put together displays and fun little side quests.
quotes.author: Amanda L.

quotes.quote: The interactive part was such a highlight and the timeliness of TR was so detailed.
quotes.author: Nancy R.

quotes.quote: Takes 2 hrs if you're quick & up to 4 hrs to fully participate & enjoy a most memorable experience!
quotes.author: Donna B.

quotes.quote: Beautiful vistas can be viewed from the rooftop and boardwalk.
quotes.author: maddylee2015

quotes.quote: The presentation using narration and technology to convey the story of Roosevelts life was simply incredible.
quotes.author: Josh G.

quotes.quote: Very beautiful; Very interactive; great seating throughout the building; food available; best be ready to walk a lot!
quotes.author: Eileen S.

quotes.quote: It has fun and interesting interactive exhibits. Perfect for a  family visit or a journey back in time
quotes.author: Sharon H.

quotes.quote: The library is an architectural and technological innovation.
quotes.author: Caryn B.

quotes.quote: The depth in which the curators has told his story makes this worthy of 10-stars, as well.
quotes.author: Kim G.

quotes.author: Rick H.

quotes.quote: Many of the displays are interactive, for adults as well as children.
quotes.author: Paige T.

quotes.quote: You can even walk on the roof as there are walking paths up there with amazing views.
quotes.author: Joshua L.

quotes.quote: The library is interactive, interesting and you could spend all day inside but leave time to take in the outside as well.
quotes.author: Nancy D.

quotes.quote: The interactive displays, the history, and the atmosphere were fantastic.
quotes.author: Keith V.

quotes.quote: Make sure you have plenty of time. It was a great experience.  I felt I really learned a lot.
quotes.author: Lois L.

quotes.quote: The Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library is packed with incredible interactive exhibits and fantastic AI-generated imagery that brings history to life.
quotes.author: Jerry J.

quotes.quote: The grounds are beautiful..walk around outside of the facility too.
quotes.author: Lisa Z.

quotes.quote: The interactive exhibits and good flow of patrons enabled us to enjoy the many sections of the museum without feeling rushed.
quotes.author: m C.

quotes.quote: Super impressed with all aspects of the Theadore Roosevelt Presidential Library!
quotes.author: Bill E.

quotes.quote: So much to read, and see. Really neat stuff throughout the entire library.
quotes.author: John K.

quotes.quote: Well thought out layout with central timeline and in depth experiences surrounding central story line. Something for everyone.

quotes.quote: As a history lover, I thoroughly enjoyed the new presidential library and so did my wife  (who is not so fond of history).
quotes.author: JWN

quotes.quote: A spectacular experience and a great experience for young and old alike
quotes.author: barbara

quotes.quote: The setting, the building, and the display experience are all amazing.  Take the time to experience all of them.
quotes.author: Dan H.

quotes.quote: We spent about 4 and a half hours here. We really enjoyed the new Technology Incorporated with all of Theodore Roosevelt's history.
quotes.author: Johnny G.

quotes.quote: loved the Theodore Roosevelt life timeline exhibit set up, extra rooms off to the sides for more depth and exploration.
quotes.author: Doreen C.

quotes.quote: A great mix of interactive exhibits, short films, and artifacts.
quotes.author: Riley J.

quotes.quote: It was very interactive which was the best part to me.  I loved the way it was laid out....according to how old  he was.

quotes.quote: Really well done, great exhibits and interactivity.  The views and walk way are great.
quotes.author: Aakash J.

quotes.quote: The library is interactive, interesting and you could spend all day inside but leave time to take in the outside as well.
quotes.author: Nancy D.

quotes.author: Greg B.

quotes.quote: The boardwalk would be perfect for a picnic lunch if you are a traveler.  It is accessible for all mobility levels and ages.

quotes.quote: Phenomenal compilation of information and artifacts to convey the character, resilience, and achievements of Mr. Roosevelt.
quotes.author: Melissa L.

quotes.quote: Great interpretation of Roosevelt's life and achievements. Interactive displays with interesting use of modern AI platforms.

quotes.quote: The interactive concept really makes the learning process fun!

quotes.author: C B.

quotes.quote: Loved the interactive nature of the exhibits!  And the view from the roof is awesome!

quotes.quote: Stunning views, great interactive opportunities,  beautiful building. All good, never felt crowded.

quotes.author: Verlee G.
